grammar.integer: parameter | integer literal | (+ I I...) | (- I) | (- I I...) | (* K I) | (* I K) | (ite B I I)

grammar.constant: K is a closed integer expression using literals, +, -, *; normalized to its exact integer value
grammar.let: SMT-LIB simultaneous, unique, non-shadowing local bindings; only expression sharing, no recursion
grammar.normalization: n-ary +/-/and/or fold; let expands without capture; closed arithmetic constant-folds
